default.title: The brief
default.text: We walk the site with you, listen to how you live and agree a budget before a single line is drawn.

default.title: The drawings
default.text: Three directions in sketch and card model, refined into one set of plans you can read without us.

default.text: We prepare the planning application and speak to the council, the neighbours and the engineer.

default.text: We tender to builders we trust and visit the site every week until the keys are in your hand.
